data.message: I individually commit to 18 tons this month—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: will you opt in? State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50, then500 or100. Recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
